sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We thank you for your proposal and deeply value the trust between our companies over the years. Our team takes immense pride in the quality we deliver from our foundry to your operations. 

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are prepared to commit to the 24-month contract you requested to ensure stability, but in return we ask to settle the payment terms at 45 days. Under these conditions, we can adjust our offer to a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This Angebot stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €50.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We appreciate your revised proposal and the constructive steps taken.
In recognition of our long-standing partnership, we are prepared to make a further concession to €50.80 per unit for the 45-day payment term.
We trust this demonstrates our commitment to finding a mutually beneficial agreement.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your continued movement and the polite, constructive dialogue between our houses. For decades, our family foundry has taken great pride in serving your firm with reliable quality from our region, and we cherish the deep trust between us.

To bridge the remaining gap, we are taking another step to a price of €50.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. We trust this fair concession reflects our commitment to our long-standing partnership and the reliable quality we deliver. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
